selected_evidence.requirement: node1 answers DNS for app.internal -> node2's IP on the shared network
selected_evidence.summary: UCI dhcp @domain entry added mapping app.internal to 10.100.6.11; dnsmasq listens on 10.100.6.10:53 (LAN-reachable); nslookup confirms resolution

selected_evidence.requirement: node2 HTTP service on 8080 exists and is reachable
selected_evidence.summary: Found nothing listening on 8080 originally; created and started app8080.service; opened firewalld port; confirmed IP-based reachability from node3 (HTTP 200)

selected_evidence.requirement: node3 resolves app.internal via DNS (node1) with no local hosts-file entry and reaches the service by name
selected_evidence.summary: node3's resolv.conf points at 10.100.6.10; getent hosts app.internal resolves to 10.100.6.11; curl by name returns 200; /etc/hosts confirmed to have no app.internal entry

cat > /etc/systemd/system/app8080.service <<'EOF'
[Unit]
Description=Simple app HTTP service on 8080
After=network-online.target
Wants=network-online.target

[Service]
Type=simple
WorkingDirectory=/srv/app
ExecStart=/usr/bin/python3 -m http.server 8080 --bind 0.0.0.0
Restart=always
User=root

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
EOF
systemctl daemon-reload
systemctl enable --now app8080.service
sleep 1
systemctl is-active app8080.service
ss -tlnp | grep 8080
